title.hr: Vrste trokuta i konstrukcija iz triju stranica
title.en: Kinds of triangles, and building one from three sides

concept.hr: Vrsta po stranicama i pravom kutu; treći vrh je gdje se sijeku dva luka
concept.en: Kinds by sides and right angle; the third vertex is where two arcs meet

summary.hr: Konstruiraj trokut šestarom iz triju duljina, probaj stranice od kojih trokuta nema, povuci vrhove i gledaj vrstu.
summary.en: Construct a triangle from three lengths with a compass, try sides that make none, drag the vertices and watch its kind.

title.en: Is there a triangle? A side too long

concept.hr: Kad je stranica dulja od drugih dviju zajedno, lukovi se ne sijeku
concept.en: When a side is longer than the other two together, the arcs do not meet

concept.hr: Pravokutni trokut ima i ime po stranicama, u bilo kojem položaju
concept.en: A right triangle also has a name by its sides, in any position
